Listen to 9to5Mac Daily, the daily news recap from 9to5Mac. 9to5Mac Daily is available on the dedicated RSS feed for podcast players including iTunes, Apple Podcasts, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, and Overcast.

Sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you get everything out of your head and neatly organized into a simple and elegant system—so you can clear off your to-dos and feel less mental clutter. A simple to-do list app designed for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make sorting, tracking, and ticking off your tasks deeply satisfying. Get stuff done with Stuff.

A new episode of 9to5Mac Daily is recorded every weekday. Subscribe to our show on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player to make sure new episodes arrive the moment they're released.

Stories covered in this episode:

  • Apple Fitness+ team reportedly hit with layoffs as "significant changes" said to be coming
  • New Mac mini drops support for after-market storage expansion
  • You can now claim your share of Apple's $250 million Siri lawsuit settlement
